image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a large adult common iguana perched on rough, grey rocks. The iguana has greyish-green skin with darker banding, a prominent dorsal crest of spines running down its neck and back, and a large circular subtympanic shield below the ear. Its head is triangular with a visible dewlap, and it is looking towards the right. The background consists of out-of-focus stone walls.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is large and triangular with a prominent dewlap (loose skin fold) hanging from the throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is clearly triangular and robust. A loose fold of skin (dewlap) is visible hanging from the lower jaw/throat area, consistent with an adult male iguana.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large with round pupils and golden irises.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the eye is large, the iris appears pale blue-grey or white rather than the characteristic golden/yellow described in the taxonomy. The pupil is not clearly distinguishable as round due to resolution/reflection, but the color mismatch is significant.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: A large circular subtympanic shield (scale) is present below the tympanum.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A very distinct, large, circular scale is clearly visible on the side of the head, directly below the ear opening (tympanum). This is a key diagnostic feature for Iguana iguana.
The torso appears thick and muscular, fitting the description of a robust body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coloration is bright green in juveniles, becoming darker green to greyish-green in adults with broad black bands on the body and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The iguana exhibits greyish-green coloration with darker, broad vertical bands on the flank, consistent with an adult specimen.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Row of enlarged, spine-like scales running from the nape along the midline of the back to the tail base, forming a serrated crest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A prominent row of sharp, spine-like scales runs continuously from the neck down the back. The structure is well-defined and anatomically correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is covered in small, granular scales with larger, plate-like scales on the head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: High-resolution details show fine, bead-like granular scales on the body and larger, smoother plates on the snout and cheek area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front left limb is clearly visible, showing muscular definition and long toes with claws. The digit count appears correct (pentadactyl).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail extends out of the frame to the left; only the base is visible. Therefore, its full length and lateral compression cannot be fully verified, though the base appears thick.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The tips of the claws on the visible front foot appear slightly soft and fused with the rock surface, lacking the sharp, distinct separation expected of hard keratin against stone. There is minor edge bleeding.

The iris color is an unnatural pale blue/white instead of gold. While this could be a rare morph or lighting effect, in AI generation, unusual eye colors often indicate a failure to capture species-specific traits accurately.
